Provenance.title: Where these numbers come from
Provenance.costBody: Cost figures are averages for each country's capital or largest city, converted to US dollars so countries stay comparable. Prices vary by neighbourhood, season and household size.
Provenance.visaBody: Visa fees and processing times are a snapshot and change without notice. Confirm every figure with the official authority before you apply or pay anything.

Consent.title: Cookies and ads
Consent.body: We use cookies to remember your language and, with your permission, to let Google AdSense show personalised ads. Ads pay for the site; declining keeps everything working, you'll just see non-personalised ads.
